name: @epoch/adapter-foundation-gltf
description: Epoch glTF 2.0 asset bridge (W060, ACR-007/X2.0) — the validated translation boundary that turns UNTRUSTED glTF/GLB bytes into content-addressed renderer-asset bindings for the frozen W056 fabric seam: pure-code parsing (zero external dependencies, zero I/O — embedded data-URI buffers and GLB BIN chunks only; external resource URIs are a typed refusal, acquisition is the host's concern), strict glTF 2.0 core-subset structural validation (asset/scenes/nodes/meshes/primitives/accessors/bufferViews/buffers/materials; indices, bounds, byte offsets, component types, declared POSITION min/max, finite-float scans, DAG-cycle detection, depth caps, extensionsRequired refusal — sparse accessors and non-triangle draw modes are typed unsupported-feature refusals), deterministic normalization into the neutral GltfAsset projection (per-primitive vertex/triangle accounting, local + scene-transformed bounds via TRS/matrix composition, material summary, non-authoritative label suggestions) whose canonical JSON digest CONTENT-ADDRESSES the validated asset, and the RendererAssetBinding factory (tenant-scoped, trust-gated: only explicitly validated assets bind; untrusted bindings never mount) plus the neutral MeshBinding projection for W016 mesh representation records. glTF files never become Epoch semantic authority (capability-foundation policy CF1.0 §5: provider-native files are source artifacts; the validated projection is the only thing Epoch adopts).
